1.0.64: Every request now has a deadline: 15 seconds for a question, 5 minutes for an upload, and then it says the connection failed instead of spinning forever.
1.0.65: Crushes now shows what Crushly is posting, not just the people you have added up with — and a new post reaches the feed without a restart.
1.0.66: Crushes now shows everything Crushly publishes, and Notifications only speaks about people: add ups, Keep Closes, Crushes, comments and mentions — never a private Whisper.
1.0.67: Adding up is a request now. Send one and it waits for an answer; when somebody adds up with you, accept or decline it right there — and you can take back a request you have not had an answer to.
1.0.68: Whisper is live. Messages arrive as they are sent, you can see when someone is typing or recording a voice note, and every Whisper you send now tells you whether it was sent, delivered or read.
1.0.69: Video notes are ten seconds and round. A Moment opens only from the ring around the picture, a Moment you have already watched now looks watched, and Top Crushes This Week only shows clips people actually crushed.
1.0.70: A gold ring now sits around somebody else’s picture and never around your own, and your Space shows only what you actually post.
1.0.71: A Space has one Add up, under the name, with Whisper beside it — the footer bar that covered the last post is gone, and Share lives in the three dots.
1.0.72: Signing up now tells you the truth about the email: the code signs you in on your phone, the link confirms you in a browser, and if a code never came, sign-in sends a fresh one.
1.0.73: One clip plays at a time — the one you are looking at — and that is the preview; everything else waits its turn, which is what stops the feed from wading.
1.0.74: Clips play again in the Crushes feed and the Flow viewer — the file was being asked for without the key that unlocks it — and a new build now installs from inside the app instead of sending you back to the browser for 95 MB.
1.0.75: A clip is the card in Crushes now — the picture fills it, the person and their words sit on it, and only Crush and comment cover the frame — and in the Flow viewer the rail and the caption sit lower, so the video has the middle of the screen to itself.
1.0.76: Your Space now looks like a Space: the cover is the picture itself with a softened copy of it behind, the Crushes tab is a wall of tall tiles you pick from instead of a feed, every tab on the page stays on the screen and tappable, and tapping a face opens the picture — or the Moments behind it, with a choice once you have seen both.
1.0.77: Every sheet now has a close button in the corner, so the Create Circle sheet — and every other one — can be put away with one tap instead of a swipe or the back key.
1.0.78: Typing your password no longer sends you to the reset screen by accident, and a Space opens with its cover as a band across the top — picture, name, Add up and all four tabs on one screen instead of a photograph and nothing else.
1.0.79: Circles on your Space use compact Android controls, the Flow player keeps the whole frame in view, and the feed starts preparing nearby photos sooner while doing less work for paused clips.
1.0.80: Advanced options now opens, and you can choose whether people may comment on a new post. The editor no longer offers a fake scheduling switch or silently drops additional media.
1.0.81: When a media upload cannot be completed, Crushly keeps your draft and reports the upload error instead of publishing a file it cannot display.
1.0.82: Crushly checks Android update downloads before opening the installer and no longer reports an update as installed when Android has not confirmed it. Optional update prompts can now be dismissed.
1.0.83: Crushly is now holUpp. On Android, save posts and Moments as drafts stored on this phone, then reopen them from the composer.
1.0.84: The app is called holUpp. Your phone-only Post and Moment drafts stay on your device.
1.0.85: The holUpp launch screen now shows the right name. Android Settings offers Update holUpp only when a newer version is available.
1.0.86: Add a separate Space banner, explore more search categories with filters, and enjoy a holUpp-styled text comment sheet.
1.0.87: Spaces without banners now have a plain background. Bios and links are easier to use, and you can share a Space from its menu.
1.0.88: Add a place name to a post without sharing your device coordinates. Only people who can see the post can see its location.
1.0.89: Open the original Moment from a Whisper reply when it is still available to you.
1.0.90: Find activity in a full-screen notification center, including private Whisper signals, and open the exact Moment from a reply.
1.0.91: Review reports, search accounts, and check admin activity; find your notifications in one full-screen place.
1.0.92: See real Add Up and Kept Close counts on Spaces and choose who can see your Add Ups.
1.0.93: Spaces keep the same banner height, show post likes and offer app navigation. holUpp admin has a dashboard with real activity totals.
1.0.94: Spaces show approved Close Ones counts with privacy controls. Verification is temporarily paused while admin review is prepared.
1.0.95: The app is holUpp everywhere now, and a saved clip carries the new mark and end card.
1.0.98: Deleting is now permanent, everywhere. A deleted post or Moment takes its photo or clip with it — the file is removed from storage, not hidden, so it can never be fetched again and the space comes back. Whispers are photos and voice notes only, two photos a day, and the editor has six real knobs (brightness, warmth, tint, fade, vignette, grain) plus a crop you can place.
1.0.99: Delete is in the Whisper menu now, and it is real: the message leaves the server and so does its photo, for both of you. No video note anywhere in a chat. Updates work again — the app checks, tells you, and installs the new build instead of sitting silently on an old one. The splash says holUpp.
1.0.100: Delete and Copy work when you tap them — the card no longer closes under your finger. A Moment card on Discover shows the Moment itself, not a camera icon. The Moments row on Crushes stays put while the feed scrolls under it. Hold the right of a clip to run it at 2×. The download is named for RielOS.
1.0.101: holUpp has its own address. Opening holupp.net, or any link shared from now on, takes you straight into the app instead of a browser tab, and the links you send carry holupp.net rather than the old Vercel name. Nothing changes about how the app behaves day to day.
1.0.102: Saving a clip works. The share sheet used to decide there was no copy before it asked the server, so a clip whose marked copy existed was told 'still being prepared', and stayed that way. It now asks, and if the answer is that the copy is still being made, it says so and lets you tap to try again instead of pretending.
1.0.103: Posting a big video no longer restarts holUpp. A clip is made smaller from the file on your phone instead of being loaded into memory first, which is what was killing the app on 200 MB recordings. And a clip you have watched stays on your phone: it plays again straight away, even with no signal, and Save clip to device can hand it to your gallery with the holUpp mark.
1.0.104: Signing in, signing up and asking for a new code now pass a quick bot check. It runs quietly in about a second and only asks you to tap anything if it thinks something is off. That is what stops fake accounts, and stops somebody using holUpp to flood an inbox.
1.0.105: The Save clip button is there the moment you post a clip, instead of minutes later. The mark and your name are burned in on the phone before the upload, so the ready-to-save copy exists as soon as the post does.
1.0.106: The web home page now says what it means: holUpp is on Android, here is the download. And posting a clip no longer fails with “we couldn’t read that file” when the phone hands over a content link instead of a real file path — it is copied first, so the post goes through.
1.0.107: Posting a clip no longer ruins its quality: the compressor now keeps 1080p and a proper bitrate instead of crushing the picture. Signing up also asks you to follow the official holUpp accounts, so updates and help find you from day one. And when a phone is out of storage, posting says so plainly instead of failing with a mystery error.
1.0.108: Video compression is more compatible across Android phones: holUpp prefers Android’s standard video encoder when available, keeps other supported codecs as fallbacks, and handles reported compression failures without discarding your original clip.
1.0.109: Posting a big video no longer closes the app. The clip is compressed once instead of three times over, so a phone that ran out of memory in the middle of a post now finishes it — and the clip still gets your name on it, because the mark is made from the smaller copy.
1.0.110: Posting a big video no longer closes the app. 1.0.109 fixed the compression; this fixes the upload after it — the clip is now sent straight from the phone's storage instead of being copied into the app's memory first, so a long video no longer runs the phone out of memory while it uploads.
1.0.111: The security check before signing in now appears instead of spinning forever. It was being stopped by a redirect inside the app — the page it loads lives on www.holupp.net and the app refused to follow it — and, once it did load, the check had nowhere to keep its state. Both are fixed, and if the check cannot run it now says so and offers Try again.
1.0.112: Three fixes. Saving a clip now works — the button was asking the server for the file without signing the request, so it came back as “your session expired”. Tapping mute, comment, Crush or Share on a playing clip no longer fast-forwards it: holding the picture still runs it at 2×, but a tap is just a tap. And a big video no longer closes the app at the start of compression — the phone now gets its video memory back before compressing, and if it runs out it says so instead of disappearing.
1.0.113: Saving a clip works again: the saved copy was being looked for in the wrong storage, so a clip that did exist came back as “not available”. And posting a big video should stop closing the app — a picked clip is now made smaller on the phone *before* the editor opens it, the players hold far less video in memory, and the app asks Android for a larger memory allowance.
1.0.114: Two follow-ups to 1.0.113. A clip is now made smaller the moment you pick it, once — not once for the editor and again for the upload — so posting no longer spends twice as long compressing. And saving a clip tries both file stores instead of only the old one, so the saved copy is found wherever it was written.
1.0.115: The security check is now validated where it is configured: the key is reduced to the 24 characters a Turnstile key actually is, the build refuses to ship a key of the wrong shape, and a check that cannot run now says that plainly instead of asking you to try again.
1.0.116: Signing in works. The web version was refused because it had no security-check key and was asking for a widget that Cloudflare no longer allows — both fixed, and verified on the live site. This build carries the same fixes plus everything from 1.0.113–1.0.115: saving a clip finds the saved copy in the right storage, a picked clip is shrunk once on the phone, and players hold far less video in memory.
1.0.117: Onboarding finishes. Step 5 of 6 saved your preferences and then went to a screen the app never registered — nothing errored, the Continue button simply stopped, and every new member stopped with it, on the web and on the phone. That step is registered now.
1.0.118: Saving a clip works. The copy the app offered you was not the copy it had uploaded, so the save always answered 'not ready yet' — and the job that repairs those copies had been reading the wrong storage since media moved, so it could never repair anything. Both fixed, and a clip you posted is saved straight from your phone instead of being downloaded back to it.
1.0.119: Same fix as 1.0.118, with the phone's own save path hardened: writing a saved clip from the device tries both media-library APIs, and the app no longer leaves its copy of a marked clip behind in the cache when the post is done with it.
1.0.120: Saving somebody else's clip works. The phone saved its own clips from the file it had already made, but a clip posted by someone else has to be fetched — and that request was riding on a sign-in token cached when the app started. Once that aged out the server refused it, and the app said your session had expired when it had not. The token is now taken fresh at the moment you tap Save, and if the server still refuses, the app renews the session once and tries again before it says anything.
1.0.121: Continue with Google now works in the app, not just in a browser. It opens a sign-in sheet, Google confirms who you are, and holUpp takes you straight back in — no email code needed. If you close the sheet, nothing happens and you can try again or use your email.
1.0.122: holUpp makes a sound now. A soft two-note chime when a Whisper arrives and a single note when a notification does — it never rings for your own actions, never rings while the app is closed, and stays quiet for the screen you are already looking at. Turn Sounds off in Notification settings if you would rather have silence.
1.0.123: Whispers and notifications now drop down at the top of the screen and stay in the notification bar until you open them, and tapping one takes you to that chat or to Notifications. While holUpp is open they arrive at once; while it is closed, Android lets holUpp check about every 15 minutes, so news can still reach you there. Notification settings has a new row that shows whether this phone is allowing it.
1.0.124: Pick your own notification sound. Notification settings has six to choose from — Glass, Pulse, Lumen, Bloom, Drip and Orbit — and tapping one plays it straight away so you choose by ear, not by name. Your choice is remembered on this phone, is the sound you hear for a Whisper, and is the sound the notification bar uses when holUpp is closed. This build also fixes the in-app banner so it appears as soon as something arrives while you are using holUpp.
1.0.125: holUpp is now registered with Firebase so a Whisper can reach you while the app is closed, not only every 15 minutes. Your phone registers itself the first time you open this build, using the notification sound you picked — so pick it before you install. Nothing looks different yet: this is the plumbing that lets a notification arrive on your lock screen the moment somebody messages you.
1.0.126: Support now comes to support@holupp.net — the same address the website and the privacy policy name — instead of a personal inbox. Everything you send from Help, Safety or feedback lands in one place somebody actually reads.
1.0.127: You can create your account with Google now, not only sign in with one. Tap Continue with Google on the create-account screen and your holUpp account is made with the name and photo already on your Google profile, so onboarding greets you by your own name. Messages to support now go to support@holupp.net.
1.0.128: Tapping left and right inside a Moment works again, hold-to-pause works, and swiping down closes it — this was broken on any Moment made from a post. Tapping somebody's name in a comment now opens their Space, not only tapping their picture. And nothing deletes on a single tap any more: every bin in holUpp asks first, and Cancel really does leave it alone.
1.0.129: Who makes holUpp is now written down where people look for it. In Settings there is a Company section: Our Company, Who owns holUpp?, and Visit RielOS — and the same sentence under the holUpp name at the bottom of the screen. holupp.net says it too, in the footer and on the About page.
1.0.131: Send a clip in a Whisper. Tap Clip in the tray, pick up to a minute of video, and it is compressed for mobile data on the way out — with a progress bar, because a silent composer looks broken. It plays inline when it arrives. Clips and photos share the same two-a-day media allowance.
1.0.130: A letter you can start. The Control Centre inbox could answer mail and could not begin it; there is now a New message button, a compose screen with To, Cc, Bcc, Subject and a Link button, and a Send from choice between support@holupp.net and info@rielincos.com.
1.0.132: The website now opens on the room instead of a pop-up. A visitor sees public posts and can search before making an account — football, animation and entertainment lead, and when there is none of that yet holUpp's own posts stand in. Sign-up now adds Up to every official account you tick, and checks with the server that it landed.
